_comment: Daily checklist data (DAILIES_MODULE.md). Traces from game-log scans. Every time here (resets, windows, usual hours) is a clock time at the UTC offset 'timesUtcOffset'; the companion moves them to the PC's own time zone by itself and, once the game log shows a daily update, to the reset moment it really saw (other server regions, daylight saving), so nobody needs to edit them.
